add_paragraph: Carlos designs and builds the hardware the science runs on: sensor grids that wake on a schedule, log for a season on a battery, and survive weather that would end a laptop in an afternoon.
The ==autonomous telemetry arrays== at Station Nord-03 and the coastal sites are his — as are the field repairs, the spare parts box and the deployment calendar.
He came to the lab from industrial instrumentation and still writes every deployment as a checklist that a visiting student can follow.
